title: The Weather Today and Tomorrow
text:
Today the weather is very nice. The sun is shining and the sky is blue. It is warm, so Anna wears a T-shirt. She goes to the park with her dog.

Tomorrow it will be different. There are big clouds in the morning, and it will rain in the afternoon. Anna takes an umbrella with her. She is not happy about the rain.

questions.text: What color is the sky today?
How does Anna feel about the weather tomorrow?
options: She is tired of her dog

questions.text: Why does Anna take an umbrella?
options: Because the sun will be very hot

vocabulary.definition: not cold, with a pleasant temperature
white or grey shapes in the sky
an object you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain

paragraph_translations: Dzisiaj pogoda jest bardzo ładna. Słońce świeci, a niebo jest niebieskie. Jest ciepło, więc Anna nosi koszulkę. Idzie do parku ze swoim psem.
Jutro będzie inaczej. Rano są duże chmury, a po południu będzie padać. Anna zabiera ze sobą parasol. Nie cieszy się z deszczu.
